selimiyecamii.name: Selimiye Mosque
selimiyecamii.slogan: Sinan's dome, lifted over the Edirne skyline.
selimiyecamii.line: …I have succeeded in building a dome six cubits higher and four cubits wider than that of the Hagia Sophia.
selimiyecamii.by: Mimar Sinan, on the Selimiye Mosque

ucserefeli.name: Üç Şerefeli Mosque
ucserefeli.slogan: Four minarets, one with three balconies to climb in your mind.
ucserefeli.line: Built between 1438 and 1447, its 67-metre minaret was the tallest Ottoman minaret of its day, and its name means three balconies.

uzunkopru.name: Uzunköprü Bridge
uzunkopru.slogan: A stone road of arches stretched across the Thracian plain.
uzunkopru.line: Finished in 1444 with 174 arches, it was once about 1.4 kilometres long; Evliya Çelebi measured it at 2,000 stretched steps in 1658.

bayezidkulliyesi.name: Bayezid II Complex
bayezidkulliyesi.slogan: A hospital where fountains and music were the medicine.
bayezidkulliyesi.line: Completed in 1488, its hospital treated mental illness with music, running water and scents until 1877.

galagolu.name: Gala Lake National Park
galagolu.slogan: Reed beds and wing beats where the Meriç meets the sea.
galagolu.line: In February 2018, nearly ten thousand flamingos overwintered at Gala Lake for the first time.
